title: Timing and size of the spring bloom
query: Using the supplied CMEMS global biogeochemical reanalysis monthly oxygen, chlorophyll and nitrate for 1993-2020 in the western Tasman Sea off south-eastern Australia (46-26 S, 147-162 E), determine when and where the spring chlorophyll bloom occurs, how its timing and size differ between the north and the south of the region and from year to year, and what controls them.

region.name: Tasman Sea and East Australian Current
